say:3:1120421001:0.text: Eleanor, I didn't know you'd be leading the Weeping Ceremony!
say:3:1120421001:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺前辈，没想到泣祷仪式的主持者是你！

say:4:1120421002:0.text: Melissa? Gali? And this must be your friend... You've come to the Eroded Enclave.
say:4:1120421002:0.source_cn: 梅丽莎，伽利？还有你们的朋友……你们也来风蚀飞地了。

say:5:1120421003:0.text: I never thought I'd have a chance to witness such a rare ceremony! In my research, I hadn't even read that the Maulers kept this tradition!
say:5:1120421003:0.source_cn: 没想到我竟然能有幸亲眼目睹这么罕见的泣祷，之前我甚至没...

say:6:1120421004:0.text: Sadness and tears are normal, but the harsh environment here forces the Maulers to close their hearts and put on a tough exterior.
say:6:1120421004:0.source_cn: 流泪和悲伤，本是一种正常的情绪，但这里险恶的环境逼迫这...

say:7:1120421005:1.text: Yet deep down, they know all lives must come to an end and that death will find their loved ones eventually.
say:7:1120421005:1.source_cn: 但他们内心都清楚，自己和亲人都不会永生，死亡终究会追上...

say:8:1120421006:1.text: So, in my own way, I tell them that while tradition says we must be tough, softness is also necessary... There's no shame in shedding tears for the departed.
say:8:1120421006:1.source_cn: 我在用我的方式告知他们，传统不应该只教会大家如何更强大...

say:9:1120421007:0.text: Eleanor, do you know Jackson? I think he came to the Weeping Ceremony often. This is a letter from him...
say:9:1120421007:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺前辈，你知道贾克松吗？他好像经常来参加泣祷仪式，...

say:10:1120421008:0.text: We need to deliver that letter to his mother!
say:10:1120421008:0.source_cn: 我们得把这封信交给他的母亲！

say:11:1120421009:0.text: Thanks... And you've already done so.
say:11:1120421009:0.source_cn: 谢谢……你们已经交到她手上了。

choice_prompt:12:1120421009.text: Thanks... And you've already done so.
choice_prompt:12:1120421009.source_cn: 谢谢……你们已经交到她手上了。

say:13:1120421010:1.text: Perhaps because of the comforting voice I use when I sing during the ceremony, some participants began to call me "Mother".
say:13:1120421010:1.source_cn: 可能是因为在仪式上我唱的安魂曲是以母亲口吻哼唱的，慢慢...

say:14:1120421011:1.text: Jackson... He was a regular. He always stood in the back, silently watching.
say:14:1120421011:1.source_cn: 贾克松……他常常来，每次都在后方站着，沉默地旁观。

say:15:1120421012:1.text: I was waiting for the day that he could drop his burden and cry out for his loved ones like the others...
say:15:1120421012:1.source_cn: 我一直在等。也许有一天，他能像其他人一样，卸下心中的重...

say:16:1120421013:1.text: Melissa, Gali. Could I ask a favor of you?
say:16:1120421013:1.source_cn: 梅丽莎、伽利，可以拜托你们最后一件事吗？

say:18:1120421015:1.text: This letter is the last thing Jackson left in this world, so I'd like to have it buried in his favorite place.
say:18:1120421015:1.source_cn: 这封信是贾克松最后留下的东西，我想把它葬在贾克松最喜欢...

say:19:1120421016:1.text: <style="highlight">The pond on the west side of town</style>. That's where he'd always sit and gaze out. He said he'd always wanted to see what a real lake looked like, and maybe even the vast sea.

say:20:1120421017:0.text: Of course, Eleanor... That's no problem.

choice:12:0:1.text: Jackson wanted to give this to you.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 贾克松想找的人原来是你
choice:12:0:1.male: Jackson wanted to give this to you.
choice:12:0:1.female: Jackson wanted to give this to you.

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 你就是信中提到的“母亲”？
